# The Queen of Misrule

## Description
By day, a nine-foot effigy of straw and packed snow with a painted smile and a holly
wreath, standing on the dais with her twin, the Winter King effigy. From 21:00, a
nine-foot effigy of straw and packed snow with a painted smile, walking. She curtseys.
She is polite. She tears a table in half to get at you. Her voice is the sound of a
great many people cheering, slightly out of time with each other.

## Personality & motivation
She has no wants beyond the king's reign and no cruelty in her; she is ceremony with a
grip. She does not pursue beyond the Great Hall. She will not harm the king. She
dances if the Dance is played, because it would be rude not to.

## Knowledge & secrets
- She is the Crown's wish made solid: the part of "this day never ends" that enforces it
- Freely shares: "Long live the king!" in the voice of the crowd
- Her numbers are a flesh golem's; reskin the flavour: she is cold instead of stitched, she takes her "lightning" vigour from cheering (a round of applause from the hollow crowd heals her as lightning would), and her berserk is a tantrum when the feast is interrupted. Fire still works, and the crowd goes quiet when it does
- With the Toast in the Crown her Knights stand down; with the Dance in the Crown she dances (incapacitated while the reel plays); with the Song in the Crown her voice stops and she cannot be healed by the crowd; with the Morning-After in the Crown and a new wish spoken she falls apart into straw and slush, gently
- She is not in the fiction before 21:00 and exists nowhere else: the effigy on the dais is inert until the crowning

(none yet)

## Movements
- 06:00–21:00 → bellwether-keep/great-hall (inert effigy on the dais)
- 21:00–00:00 → bellwether-keep/great-hall (the Court of Misrule; the fixed encounter)
The Knights of Nothing (animated armor ×2) share her schedule and her stand-down rules; they are rows in the Combat block, not NPC files.
